newState.content: Schema map: {"table":"lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.vendor","columns":["vendor_id varchar(20)","vendor_name varchar(100)","currency varchar(3)"],"description":"vendors (id, name, invoicing currency)"}

Schema map: {"table":"lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.vendor_bill","columns":["vendor_invoice_no varchar(40)","vendor_id varchar(20)","ap_doc_id varchar(20)","invoice_date varchar(10)","period varchar(7)","currency varchar(3)","amount_orig double","fx_rate double","amount_cad double"],"description":"one row per vendor invoice number booked in AP (PK = vendor_invoice_no; DQ flags invoices entered twice); amount_cad uses the BoC rate on the invoice date"}

Schema map: {"table":"lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.vendor_payment","columns":["txn_id varchar(20)","vendor_invoice_no varchar(40)","booking_date varchar(10)","period varchar(7)","counterparty varchar(100)","currency_orig varchar(3)","amount_orig double","amount_cad double"],"description":"vendor payments from the bank feed; vendor_invoice_no comes from the payment reference"}

Schema map: {"table":"lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.product","columns":["sku varchar(20)","product_name varchar(100)","category varchar(30)","list_price_cad double","wholesale_price_cad double"],"description":"SKUs with category, retail list price and wholesale price"}

Schema map: {"table":"lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.customer","columns":["customer_id varchar(20)","customer_name varchar(100)","channel varchar(20)"],"description":"customers with channel retail or wholesale"}

Schema map: {"table":"lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.sales_line","columns":["sales_line_id varchar(40)","order_id varchar(30)","period varchar(7)","customer_id varchar(20)","sku varchar(20)","qty double","unit_price_cad double","revenue_cad double"],"description":"order lines: period, customer, sku, qty, revenue_cad"}

Schema map: {"table":"lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line","columns":["purchase_line_id varchar(40)","ap_doc_id varchar(20)","vendor_invoice_no varchar(40)","vendor_id varchar(20)","period varchar(7)","sku varchar(20)","qty double","currency varchar(3)","unit_price_orig double","contract_unit_price double","fx_rate double","unit_cost_cad double","amount_cad double"],"description":"AP invoice lines: vendor, sku (PKG = packaging), qty, unit_price_orig in invoice currency, contract_unit_price, fx_rate, unit_cost_cad, amount_cad"}

Schema map: {"table":"lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.gl_balance","columns":["gl_key varchar(20)","period varchar(7)","account_code varchar(10)","account_name varchar(100)","account_type varchar(10)","amount_cad double"],"description":"monthly general ledger balance per account: account_type revenue (positive), cogs (5000 goods, 5100 packaging), opex (6100 marketing …)"}
Schema map: {"table":"lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.fx_rate","columns":["rate_date varchar(10)","usdcad double"],"description":"Bank of Canada USD/CAD daily rate (live REST source)"}
Operating expenses (account type opex, e.g. 6100 Marketing) sit below gross margin: never report them as gross-margin drivers.

Confirmed by the controller: Vendor VEND-MRP invoice MRP-88213 was booked twice in AP (AP-00030 and AP-00031) for 12,450 CAD each in September 2026 but paid only once (payment BNK-00030), causing an overstatement of expenses by 12,450 CAD in September vs August. (CAD 12,450). Evidence: E8-2 finance_usl.vendor_bill+finance_usl.vendor_payment 1 rows; E8-3 finance_usl.vendor_bill 2 rows; E8-4 finance_usl.vendor_payment 1 rows. Note: controller checked the source documents. Check this first at the next close.

Confirmed by the controller: Vendor VEND-SNC paid above contract prices for SKUs NUT-ALM, NUT-CAS, NUT-PEC in September 2026, increasing average purchase cost per unit from 18.70 to 20.98 CAD and adding approximately 9,143 CAD of excess cost. (CAD 9,116). Evidence: E4-1 finance_usl.purchase_line 3 rows; E4-2 finance_usl.purchase_line 2 rows; E4-3 finance_usl.purchase_line 6 rows; E4-4 finance_usl.purchase_line 10 rows. Note: controller checked the source documents. Check this first at the next close.
